meta_title: Mosmos — an AI sidekick that gets in sync the more you use it
meta_description: Hand off the busywork and focus on what matters. A personal AI that helps you research, organize, and write. Join early and we'll let you know first when we're ready.
hero_tagline: An AI sidekick that gets in sync the more you use it
hero_sub: Most AI stops at a draft. Here, several specialist AIs split the work and bring back a result you can actually use.
hero_anchor: The AI sidekick lives in a world designed for AIs called Mosmos.
hero_trust: We'll let you know first, the moment we're ready
consent_label: (Required) I agree to the collection and use of my personal information
consent_microcopy: We'll share launch and first-invite news, and stories from building it. You can unsubscribe anytime.
empathy_loss: Sometimes telling your AI what to do quietly becomes one more task of its own.
empathy_gain: From here, your AI takes that part off your plate.
demo_title: Hand it off — Mos picks the right specialist AIs and finishes it
demo_sub: We'll show you exactly how a few words turn into a finished result.
demo_chat_user: Research this quarter's market and turn it into a deck for me
demo_chat_ai: On it. I'll bring in the specialist AIs this needs.
demo_mon_gloss: Mos picks the right specialist AIs — from my collection (the ones I've gathered) or the shared hub (a pool anyone can use) — then merges their work into one result.
demo_chat_ai2: The deck you asked for is ready — take a look.
mos_eyebrow: Your AI has a name — Mos
mos_title: The AI you can just hand things to — Mos
mos_gloss: Mos is your own AI sidekick, made by Mosmos — it stays with you and helps with your work.
mos_skilled_sub: It works to your tasks and your way — no one else's.
mos_mon_hint: For the hard parts, it works with the specialist AIs alongside it.
loop_eyebrow: A world where my AI grows
loop_title: The more you use it, the more your AI grows
loop_lead: Hand off the work, the ways that fit become yours to keep, and that value comes back as better results — a loop that keeps tuning to you.
loop_step1_desc: Just say the result you want; Mos takes it from there.
loop_step2_desc: The ways and specialist AIs that fit become yours.
loop_step3_desc: If you like, pass the good ones on to others.
loop_step4_desc: What you've built up comes back, fitting you better each time.
loop_kicker: Not a tool that empties out as you use it — an AI that grows right alongside you.
founder_note: Hi — we're building Mosmos. We'll look after every first invite ourselves, and we'd rather share how it's coming together, honestly, than only the finished picture.
trust_care: We only welcome as many people at a time as we can truly look after.
trust_cta_title: First in line, when we're ready
social_count: {count} people are already here with us
recruit_title: Build Mosmos with us, as an early member?
recruit_text: If that sounds like you, take a look.
recruit_cta: See how to join the team
confirm_title: Welcome! As soon as we're ready, we'll send your invite from the front of the line.
confirm_email_sent: We've sent a welcome email — check your inbox!
confirm_care: We start small and invite people a few at a time, because we want to listen closely to each person's story.
confirm_next: From here on, we'll share stories from building it now and then.
confirm_world_tagline: Another me, in the digital world
survey_intro: Want to be invited first? Just 30 more seconds — what you share helps decide the invite order.
survey_ai_label: What do you mostly use AI for these days?
survey_task_other_label: Other — tell us what kind of work
survey_done: Thank you! We'll keep what you shared close.
error_no_consent: Check the consent box and we'll sign you up right away.
error_duplicate: You're already with us! We'll be the first to reach out when we're ready.
error_ratelimit: Lots of requests just now. Please try again in a moment.
error_generic: Something went wrong for a moment. Please try again shortly.
gated_stat_n45: Of the 45 people we met, nearly half were spending over 30 minutes on a single piece of research
privacy_intro: Mosmos collects only the minimum information needed for waitlist signup, within the scope below.
privacy_consent: We don't store anything without your consent. You can withdraw it anytime — to be removed, just let us know through the contact channel.
privacy_optional: Survey answers like your job and the AI tasks you do are optional, and are used only to decide the first-invite order.
